report.title: Analyst reporting dashboard
report.subtitle: Registered recommendations, recorded scores and linked simulated fills for the analysts bound to this group.
report.method: Coverage uses all active recommendations. A hit follows the direction of the five-session return. Scores use direction-adjusted 20-session returns, falling back to five sessions. Hold calls have no directional assessment.
report.noMembers: No formal analysts are bound to this group.
report.noRecs: No registered recommendations in this selection.
report.noTrades: No simulated fills are linked to recommendations in this selection.
report.noRecTrades: This recommendation has no linked simulated fills.
report.loading: Loading registered recommendations, scores and fills…
report.failed: The formal report could not be read. Retry or check the account linked to this group.
report.denied: This dashboard is available to the formal simulated account bound to the group.
report.login: Sign in to the bound simulated account to view the report.

analysis.title: Recommendation and execution report
analysis.registration: Registered recommendations total {registered}, with {active} active and {withdrawn} withdrawn.
analysis.concentration: {ticker} has the most recommendations ({count}). Buy/add calls total {buys}, sell/trim calls {sells}, and hold/pass calls {others}.

analysis.noHit: Active recommendations have no recorded hit outcomes yet. A hit rate requires an assessed sample.

analysis.currency: {currency} executions include {buys} buys and {sells} sells, with gross traded value of {gross} {currency} and fees of {fees} {currency}.

title: Analyst Scoring
subtitle: Simulated books and forward scores for analyst recommendations. Research happens on the Research page, real trades under Portfolio; this page only answers: if the recommendations were followed, how did they do?
disclaimer: Analyst simulated books are hypothetical-fill scorekeeping. Past scores do not predict future results and nothing here constitutes investment advice.

profiles.title: Analysts · {count}
profiles.empty: No analyst profiles yet — create one, or record the first recommendation under “Me”.

profile.archiveConfirm: Archiving hides this analyst from the overview; existing recommendations and scores are kept. Archive?

recommendationForm.title: Record Recommendation
recommendationForm.unsupportedTicker: Only A-share, HK and US tickers are supported
recommendationForm.referencePrice: Reference Price (as stated; not the fill price)
recommendationForm.saved: Recorded. The simulated fill price and score appear after the next “Refresh Scores”.

book.rule: Equal-weight rule: each buy/add opens 1 unit, trim removes 1, sell closes all; the simulated fill is the K-line close on the recommendation day. No cash, fees, FX, dividends or split adjustments. Score = direction-adjusted 20d return (5d when 20d is missing).
